products.name: Advanced Biomaterial Products
products.description: Off-the-shelf placental-derived allogeneic biomaterial products, including allografts and connective tissue matrices, used for soft tissue repair, wound care, and reconstructive procedures. These are manufactured from human placental tissue using proprietary processing and are delivered as ready-to-use medical devices or grafts.

products.name: Placental-Derived Allogeneic Cell Therapies
products.description: Off-the-shelf, inventory-ready cellular therapies derived from human placental tissue, including mesenchymal-like adherent stromal cells (MLASCs), natural killer (NK) cells, and genetically modified variants, for use in treating aging-related and degenerative diseases. These are manufactured using proprietary cell selection, expansion, and cryopreservation processes in a cGMP facility.

products.name: Biobanking Services
products.description: Fee-based collection, processing, cryogenic preservation, and long-term storage of birth byproducts such as umbilical cord blood and placental-derived cells and tissue for third parties, primarily expectant parents. Services are provided in a dedicated facility and include both initial processing and ongoing storage.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing and Development Services
products.description: Contract manufacturing and development services for third-party companies, focusing on the development and manufacture of advanced biomaterial and cell therapy products for clinical trials. Services leverage proprietary expertise and cGMP manufacturing infrastructure to support external clients' product development and scale-up.

products.name: Multifamily Apartment Rental Services
products.description: Leasing and managing apartment homes within multifamily communities owned, developed, or acquired by the company. This service is delivered through physical property management, on-site staff, and leasing operations across a geographically diverse portfolio.

products.name: Sanitaryware
products.description: Includes toilets, sinks, pedestals, and toilet seats, primarily sourced from third-party suppliers in China and sold under both private label and company-owned brands. These are physical products requiring manufacturing and global supply chain logistics.

products.name: Bath Furniture
products.description: Wood and wood-substitute bathroom furniture including vanities, mirrors, laundry and medicine cabinets, and storage systems, sourced mainly from Southeast Asia and China, sold under company and private label brands. These are manufactured physical goods.

products.name: Shower Systems
products.description: Shower-related products such as shower walls, doors, and basins, sourced from third-party suppliers in China and Southeast Asia, sold under private label and company brands. These are manufactured physical products distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Custom Kitchen Cabinetry
products.description: Custom kitchen cabinetry products, including high-margin, high-quality cabinets, sold primarily through local kitchen and bath dealerships and involving significant marketing to contractors and designers. These are manufactured to order, often from company-owned facilities in Southeast Asia.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Information and Analytics
products.description: Subscription-based access to a comprehensive platform of commercial real estate intelligence, including property data, leasing and sales information, tenant and owner analytics, market trends, benchmarking, and risk management tools. Delivered digitally via web-based platforms and SaaS solutions, requiring proprietary data collection, research, and analytics infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Online Marketplaces
products.description: Online platforms for marketing, advertising, and searching commercial properties for sale or lease, including LoopNet and international sites. Delivered digitally, leveraging proprietary databases and subscription-based ad packages for property owners, landlords, and brokers.

products.name: 3D Digital Twin Technology and Services
products.description: Subscription-based and transaction-based services providing 3D digital twins of properties, including capture services, AI-powered property insights, and the sale of 3D capture cameras and devices. Requires advanced imaging technology, spatial data capture, and digital delivery.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Auction Platform
products.description: An online auction platform (Ten-X) for commercial real estate, providing brokers, sellers, and buyers with data-driven technology and marketing tools to facilitate property sales. Delivered digitally, with transaction-based fees calculated as a percentage of the final sales price.

products.name: Business-for-Sale Marketplace
products.description: An online marketplace (BizBuySell) for listing and searching operating businesses and franchises for sale. Sellers pay to list, and buyers can search listings for free. Delivered digitally, leveraging proprietary listing and search technology.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Online Marketplaces
products.description: Digital platforms aggregating and marketing residential real estate listings for sale or rent, including Apartments.com, Homes.com, Land.com, Domain, and OnTheMarket. Services include lead generation, marketing, and AI-powered search experiences for agents, owners, and property managers.

products.name: Real Estate and Lease Management Software
products.description: SaaS platforms and related professional services (CoStar Real Estate Manager, Visual Lease) providing real estate and lease management technology solutions for lease administration, lease accounting, and transaction management. Delivered digitally, requiring ongoing software development and support.

products.name: Entolimod (TLR5 Agonist Therapeutics)
products.description: A recombinant protein therapeutic developed and manufactured using CGMP processes, delivered via intramuscular or subcutaneous injection, for the treatment of acute radiation syndrome (ARS) and oncology-related conditions such as neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and mucositis. Produced through plasmid expression in E. coli and supplied as a sterile liquid in single-use vials.

products.name: Entolasta (Next-Generation TLR5 Agonist Therapeutics)
products.description: A second-generation, pharmacologically optimized recombinant protein therapeutic with reduced immunogenicity, designed for repeated dosing in chronic or multi-cycle settings such as immunosenescence, chronic radiation exposure, and oncology supportive care. Manufactured using advanced protein engineering and biomanufacturing techniques.

products.name: Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) Services
products.description: Through its subsidiary Velocity Bioworks, Tivic offers contract development and manufacturing services for cellular and biologic therapies to third-party biopharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Services include analytical testing, process development, and CGMP manufacturing, delivered from a purpose-built facility in San Antonio, Texas.

products.name: Synthetic Lethality-Based Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Small molecule drugs designed to selectively target and kill cancer cells with specific genetic mutations by exploiting synthetic lethality in DNA damage response (DDR) pathways. These therapies are developed through in-house discovery and are delivered as orally bioavailable pharmaceuticals, requiring regulated clinical development and manufacturing.

products.name: WEE1 Inhibitor (APR-1051)
products.description: An orally bioavailable small molecule inhibitor of the WEE1 kinase, developed for the treatment of advanced solid tumors with specific genetic mutations. Manufactured synthetically and delivered as a pharmaceutical product through clinical trials, with the aim of commercial distribution upon approval.

products.name: ATR Inhibitor (ATRN-119, Mosipasertib)
products.description: An orally bioavailable macrocyclic small molecule inhibitor of ATR kinase, intended for use in patients with advanced solid tumors having defined DDR-related gene mutations. Developed and manufactured as a pharmaceutical product, with ongoing clinical trials and potential for combination therapy.

products.name: DYRK1A/B Inhibitor (APR-1602)
products.description: A preclinical macrocyclic small molecule inhibitor targeting DYRK1A/B kinases, intended for future development as a precision oncology therapeutic. Manufactured synthetically and planned for clinical development as an oral pharmaceutical product.

products.name: P53 Reactivator (APR-246, eprenetapopt)
products.description: A small molecule drug candidate designed to reactivate mutant p53 tumor suppressor protein in cancer cells. Previously developed and tested in clinical trials, but not currently in active development. Manufactured synthetically for pharmaceutical use.

products.name: Active Investment Management Services
products.description: Provision of actively managed investment strategies across multiple asset classes, market capitalizations, and investment styles, delivered through separate accounts, mutual funds, collective investment trusts, and private funds. Services are provided by specialized investment teams and require significant human capital, financial expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Credit and Fixed Income Investment Management
products.description: Management of credit and fixed income investment strategies, including high income, credit opportunities, floating rate, and custom credit solutions, delivered through separate accounts and pooled vehicles. Requires financial expertise, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Emerging Markets and Developing World Investment Management
products.description: Provision of investment management services focused on emerging markets and developing world equities and debt, delivered through specialized strategies and vehicles. Involves in-depth research, local market expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Real Estate Private Equity Investment Management
products.description: Origination, development, acquisition, and management of middle market real estate properties through private equity funds, requiring specialized real estate expertise, capital deployment, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Vehicle Fuel
products.description: Procurement, production, and distribution of renewable natural gas (RNG) derived from biogas (dairy, livestock waste, landfills), delivered as compressed (CNG) or liquefied (LNG) fuel for medium and heavy-duty vehicles. RNG is produced at company-owned or partner facilities, injected into pipelines, and dispensed at fueling stations operated or supplied by the company.

products.name: Conventional Natural Gas Vehicle Fuel (CNG and LNG)
products.description: Procurement and distribution of conventional natural gas, compressed (CNG) or liquefied (LNG), for use as vehicle fuel. Gas is sourced from utilities or marketers, compressed or liquefied at company or third-party facilities, and dispensed at fueling stations.

products.name: Bulk Natural Gas Sales for Non-Vehicle Use
products.description: Sales and transport of CNG and LNG to industrial, institutional, marine, rail, and utility customers for non-vehicle applications, including via virtual pipelines using high-capacity trailers and delivery to customers without direct pipeline access.

products.name: Environmental Credits Sales (RINs and LCFS Credits)
products.description: Generation and sale of federal and state environmental credits (RINs, LCFS Credits) associated with dispensing RNG as vehicle fuel. Credits are sold to third parties obligated to comply with emissions regulations.

products.name: Fueling Station Construction and Engineering Services
products.description: Design, engineering, and construction of public and private natural gas and RNG fueling stations for customers, including acting as general contractor or supervising third-party contractors. Stations may be sold or leased to customers.

products.name: Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Services for Fueling Stations
products.description: Provision of maintenance and operational services for company-owned and customer-owned fueling stations, supported by a network of technicians, remote monitoring, and inventory warehouses. Services are provided for a fixed or per-gallon fee.

products.name: Equipment Sales and Servicing for RNG and Natural Gas Stations
products.description: Sales and servicing of compressors, storage tanks, dispensers, and related equipment used in RNG and natural gas fueling stations and production facilities.

products.name: Grant and Incentive Program Assistance
products.description: Assistance to fleet customers in applying for and obtaining federal, state, and local grants, tax credits, and incentives for vehicle purchases, fueling station construction, and fuel sales.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate loans (owner-occupied, non-owner occupied, multifamily, income-producing), equipment and inventory financing, working capital loans, term business loans, agricultural loans, and Small Business Administration loans. These are delivered through in-person banking centers and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates and services residential real estate loans secured by 1-4 family properties, including fixed and adjustable-rate mortgages, construction-to-permanent loans, and home equity lines of credit. Loans are originated through branches and online, with some sold to secondary markets (e.g., Freddie Mac) with servicing retained.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides secured and unsecured consumer installment loans for personal use, home improvements, automobiles, boats, and recreational vehicles. These loans are delivered through branch locations and require in-person application and underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a variety of deposit products to consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market accounts, NOW accounts, certificates of deposit, and IRA accounts. Delivered through physical branches and online banking platforms, these services require regulated infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Online and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Provides digital banking services such as online banking, bill payment for individuals, and online cash management for businesses via the company’s website. These are delivered digitally and require investment in secure IT infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Offers a variety of insurance products to retail and business customers, including home, renters, automobile, pet, identity theft, travel, and professional liability insurance. These services are provided through a dedicated subsidiary and require regulatory compliance and partnerships with insurance carriers.

products.name: Investment Services
products.description: Provides investment management services through a subsidiary that holds and manages an investment portfolio, including cash accounts and securities. These services are primarily for managing company assets but may also be offered to customers as investment products.

products.name: Safe Deposit and Ancillary Banking Services
products.description: Offers safe deposit facilities, travelers’ checks, official checks, money orders, and ATM services to customers through branch locations. These are physical services requiring secure infrastructure and regulatory oversight.

products.name: QTORIN Rapamycin Topical Gel
products.description: A novel, patented anhydrous topical gel formulation containing rapamycin, developed using the QTORIN platform, designed to deliver high concentrations of rapamycin to the deep layers of the skin with minimal systemic absorption. It is produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing and is intended for chronic, local treatment of serious, rare skin diseases and vascular malformations, including microcystic lymphatic malformations, cutaneous venous malformations, and clinically significant angiokeratomas, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: QTORIN Pitavastatin Topical Gel
products.description: A topical gel formulation containing pitavastatin, developed using the QTORIN platform, designed to deliver pitavastatin directly to the skin to inhibit the mevalonate pathway. It is intended as a pathogenesis-directed therapy for disseminated superficial actinic porokeratosis (DSAP), a rare, premalignant skin disease, and is produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing for local application, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: QTORIN Platform-Based Therapies for Rare Skin Diseases and Vascular Malformations (Pipeline)
products.description: A pipeline of additional preclinical and clinical-stage topical therapies developed using the QTORIN platform, targeting serious, rare skin diseases and vascular malformations with significant unmet needs. These therapies are formulated as topical gels to deliver various active pharmaceutical ingredients locally to the skin, minimizing systemic exposure, and are produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing. Specific future indications and APIs are under evaluation and development.

products.name: Power Transmission Products
products.description: Manufactured, highly engineered elastomer drive belts (including synchronous and asynchronous belts), metal drive components, and related kits used to transfer power, convey materials, and provide motion control in a wide range of industrial, automotive, and personal mobility applications. Products are produced using proprietary polymer formulations, textiles, and embedded cords, and are delivered through global manufacturing and distribution networks.

products.name: Fluid Power Products
products.description: Manufactured hoses, tubing, fittings, and assemblies designed to convey hydraulic fluid at high pressures or transfer fluids, gases, or granular materials in both mobile and stationary applications. Products include hydraulic hoses, couplings, thermal management hoses, emissions reduction hoses, and industrial hoses, produced using advanced materials and engineering for demanding environments and delivered globally.

products.name: Private Label Snacking Products
products.description: Manufacture and supply of private label snacking products including crackers, pretzels (traditional, filled, enrobed, seasoned), in-store bakery items, frozen griddle items, cookies, and unique candy offerings. Products are produced in company-owned facilities and delivered in shelf stable, refrigerated, and frozen formats to retail, foodservice, and co-manufacturing customers.

products.name: Private Label Beverage & Drink Mix Products
products.description: Production and supply of private label beverage and drink mix products including non-dairy creamer, coffee (roasted, ground, single-serve pod), broths/stocks, powdered beverages, other blends, and tea. Products are manufactured in company facilities and distributed to retail, foodservice, and co-manufacturing customers in various formats.

products.name: Private Label Pickles and Pickled Products
products.description: Manufacture and supply of private label and select branded pickles and pickled products, including pickles, pickled beets, horseradish, and pickled onions. Products are produced in company facilities and distributed primarily to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Private Label Refrigerated and Frozen Grocery Products
products.description: Production and supply of private label refrigerated dough, hot cereal, cheese & pudding, and frozen griddle items. Products are manufactured in company facilities and distributed in refrigerated or frozen formats to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Electric Power Transmission and Distribution Infrastructure Services
products.description: Comprehensive design, engineering, procurement, construction, upgrade, repair, and maintenance services for overhead and underground electric power transmission and distribution networks and substation facilities. Delivered through labor-intensive field operations using specialized equipment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Renewable Power Generation and Battery Storage Infrastructure Services
products.description: Engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), repowering, and maintenance services for utility-scale wind, solar, hydropower generation, and battery storage facilities. Delivered via project-based construction and technical field services.

products.name: Emergency Restoration Services
products.description: Rapid-response repair and restoration of electric and communications infrastructure damaged by fires, storms, and other disasters. Delivered through mobilized field crews and specialized equipment, often under urgent conditions.

products.name: Smart Grid and Advanced Electrical Systems Installation
products.description: Design and installation of smart grid technologies and advanced electrical systems for utilities and large load centers, including data centers and industrial facilities. Involves integration of digital and automated systems into physical infrastructure.

products.name: Communications Infrastructure Services
products.description: Design, construction, installation, maintenance, and repair of wireline and wireless communications networks, including fiber optic and 5G infrastructure. Delivered through field construction, engineering, and technical services.

products.name: Gas Utility Infrastructure Services
products.description: Design, engineering, procurement, construction, upgrade, repair, and maintenance of natural gas utility systems, including pipeline protection, integrity testing, and replacement. Delivered through regulated, field-based construction and technical services.

products.name: Pipeline and Midstream Infrastructure Services
products.description: Engineering, construction, maintenance, and specialty services for oil and gas pipeline transmission, storage, compressor and pump stations, including fabrication and integrity management. Delivered via large-scale, regulated field projects.

products.name: Downstream Industrial and Petrochemical Services
products.description: Specialty services for refineries and petrochemical plants, including catalyst replacement, high-pressure turnaround, instrumentation, electrical, piping, fabrication, storage tank, and environmental solutions. Delivered through skilled labor and specialized equipment at industrial sites.

products.name: Mechanical, Plumbing, and Process Infrastructure Solutions for Large Load Centers
products.description: Turnkey mechanical, plumbing, and process infrastructure solutions for data centers, manufacturing, semiconductor, healthcare, and other large facilities. Delivered through project-based construction and technical services.

products.name: Civil Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Site clearing, earthwork, soil stabilization, and infrastructure development services for utility, industrial, and commercial projects. Delivered through heavy equipment and skilled labor.

products.name: Energy Transition and Carbon Reduction Infrastructure Services
products.description: Engineering, construction, and maintenance services for alternative fuel facilities, carbon capture systems, hydrogen facilities, and related energy transition projects. Delivered through specialized project teams and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Aviation Services for Utility and Infrastructure Projects
products.description: Aviation services including transportation of line workers, pole and tower setting, wire stringing, and emergency aerial firefighting, primarily for utility infrastructure projects. Delivered using a proprietary fleet of helicopters and aircraft.

products.name: Manufacturing of Utility Infrastructure Components
products.description: Manufacturing of power transformers, circuit breakers, wood utility poles, laminated wood products, and other critical components for electric and communications infrastructure. Delivered through dedicated manufacturing facilities.

products.name: HT-001 (Topical Therapy for Cancer Drug-Induced Skin Disorders)
products.description: A topical pharmaceutical formulation under development for treating dermatological side effects, such as rash and skin disorders, associated with cancer therapies (notably EGFR inhibitors). Delivered as a topical medication, it is intended to be used alongside cancer treatments to improve patient outcomes.

products.name: HT-KIT (Therapy for Mast Cell Cancers and Anaphylaxis)
products.description: A targeted drug therapy designed to inhibit the KIT receptor tyrosine kinase in mast cells, developed for the treatment of mast cell-derived cancers (such as mastocytosis and mast cell leukemia) and for the prevention or treatment of anaphylaxis. Delivered as a pharmaceutical agent, it is being developed through preclinical and clinical studies.

products.name: HT-ALZ (Therapy for Alzheimer’s and Neuroinflammatory Diseases)
products.description: A pharmaceutical product using the active ingredient of HT-001, developed for the treatment and prevention of Alzheimer’s disease and other neuroinflammatory conditions. The product is being formulated for patient use and is advancing through preclinical and formulation development stages.

products.name: BioLexa Platform (Topical Therapy for Eczema/Atopic Dermatitis)
products.description: A proprietary topical drug platform combining a zinc chelator and antibiotics (such as gentamicin) to treat eczema (atopic dermatitis) by preventing biofilm formation and sweat duct clogging. Delivered as a topical dosage form, it is being developed for human use under regulatory pathways for repurposed drugs.

products.name: HT-004 (Inhalational Therapy for Asthma and Allergies)
products.description: A disease-modifying agent using exon-skipping oligonucleotide-targeted methods to reduce mast cell responses, under development for the treatment of asthma and allergic diseases. Delivered via inhalational administration, it is currently in preclinical investigation.

products.name: HT-VA (Therapy for Obesity and Related Conditions)
products.description: A pharmaceutical product based on glial cell line derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF) receptor agonists, developed for the treatment and prevention of obesity, metabolic syndrome, and insulin resistance. Delivered via parental administration, it is in preclinical development.

products.name: Dedicated Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Provides truckload transportation services dedicated to specific customers, typically for retail distribution centers or manufacturing facilities, using company-operated or independent contractor trucks with dry van or specialized trailers. Services are delivered through long-term contracts and require physical assets and in-person labor.

products.name: One-Way Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Offers medium-to-long-haul, expedited, regional, and temperature-controlled truckload transportation for a variety of commodities, including consumer products and retail merchandise, using company-operated and independent contractor trucks. Services are provided over irregular routes across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, requiring significant physical assets and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Truckload Logistics (Brokerage and Freight Management)
products.description: Provides non-asset-based truckload logistics services by using contracted carriers to complete shipments for brokerage and freight management customers, offering single-source logistics management solutions. Delivery is digital and service-based, leveraging third-party capacity and information systems.

products.name: Intermodal Transportation Services
products.description: Offers intermodal transportation by arranging rail transport through alliances with rail and drayage providers as an alternative to truck transportation. This service is non-asset-based and relies on partnerships with railroads and drayage companies to move freight across North America.

products.name: Final Mile Delivery Services
products.description: Provides residential and commercial delivery of large or heavy items using two-person delivery teams, third-party agents, independent contractors, and company employees, utilizing liftgate straight trucks. This service is asset-intensive and labor-driven, focusing on the last leg of the delivery process.

products.name: Used Truck and Trailer Sales
products.description: Sells used trucks and trailers through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Werner Fleet Sales, operating at multiple locations. This is a secondary, asset-based business line leveraging the company’s fleet turnover.

products.name: Commercial Excess and Personal Umbrella Insurance
products.description: Provides excess liability coverage above primary liability policies for commercial clients and personal umbrella coverage above homeowners’ and automobile liability policies. Delivered through underwriting and policy issuance, requiring regulatory compliance and risk assessment.

products.name: Commercial Transportation Insurance
products.description: Offers commercial automobile liability and physical damage insurance for truckers, public transportation entities, and other specialty commercial auto risks, including related coverages such as general liability, excess liability, and motor truck cargo. Delivered via underwriting and claims management, requiring specialized risk evaluation.

products.name: General Liability Insurance
products.description: Provides third-party liability coverage for commercial insureds such as manufacturers, contractors, apartments, and mercantile businesses, including environmental liability for specific risks. Delivered through tailored underwriting and regulated policy forms.

products.name: Professional Liability Insurance
products.description: Offers errors and omissions and related liability coverages for small to medium-sized professionals (design, technical, computer, etc.), often as part of multi-peril packages including property, auto, and workers’ compensation. Delivered via specialized underwriting and claims handling.

products.name: Small Commercial Insurance Packages
products.description: Provides property and casualty insurance packages for small to mid-sized contractors, including general liability, inland marine, commercial auto, property, and excess liability. Delivered through packaged underwriting and distributed via agents and digital platforms.

products.name: Executive and Management Liability Insurance
products.description: Delivers management liability coverages such as directors and officers (D&O), fiduciary, employment practices, and fidelity insurance for public and private businesses. Requires specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Other Casualty Insurance Products
products.description: Includes home business insurance, assumed reinsurance for general liability, excess, commercial auto, property, professional liability, mortgage reinsurance, and package coverages via binding authority. Delivered through various underwriting channels and agreements.

products.name: Commercial Property Insurance
products.description: Provides excess and surplus lines and specialty property insurance for commercial and industrial risks, including fire, earthquake, wind, and difference in conditions (DIC) coverages. Requires physical risk assessment, catastrophe modeling, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Marine Insurance
products.description: Offers marine coverages including cargo, hull, protection and indemnity, marine liability, and inland marine (builders’ risks, contractors’ equipment). Delivered through specialized underwriting and claims management, with some international exposure.

products.name: Specialized Homeowners’ and Dwelling Fire Insurance
products.description: Provides specialized homeowners’ and dwelling fire insurance, primarily in Hawaii, and property coverages via binding authority. Delivered through underwriting and agent distribution.

products.name: Transactional Surety Bonds
products.description: Issues small surety bonds for businesses and individuals, such as license and permit, notary, and court bonds, using highly automated underwriting and delivery systems.

products.name: Commercial Surety Bonds
products.description: Provides surety bonds for medium to large-sized businesses across various industries, requiring financial and risk assessment and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Contract Surety Bonds
products.description: Offers performance and payment bonds for small to medium-sized contractors, guaranteeing contractual obligations for construction projects, including bonds reinsured through the SBA. Delivered via account-based underwriting.

products.name: Specialty Reinsurance
products.description: Provides specialty reinsurance on a portfolio basis, including excess of loss and proportional contracts, for unique and volatile underlying exposures. Delivered through negotiated contracts with reinsurance clients.

products.name: Workers’ Compensation Insurance
products.description: Insurance policies providing wage replacement and medical care benefits to employees injured in the course of employment, primarily for small to mid-sized employers in hazardous industries. Policies are underwritten, priced, and serviced directly by the company and delivered through independent agencies.

products.name: Assumed Workers’ Compensation Reinsurance (Mandatory Pooling Arrangements)
products.description: Participation in state-mandated residual market programs by assuming reinsurance premiums, sharing in the results of pooled workers’ compensation policies for employers unable to obtain coverage in the voluntary market. Delivered through state pooling mechanisms.

products.name: Private Debt Investments
products.description: Origination and management of loans to privately-held companies, including senior secured first lien and second lien term loans, unitranche loans, and unsecured subordinated debt. These are structured, underwritten, and monitored by the internal investment team and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Private Equity Investments
products.description: Direct equity investments in privately-held companies, including common and preferred equity, as well as warrants and minority equity securities. These investments are sourced, structured, and monitored by the investment team and require financial capital and due diligence.

products.name: Asset-Based Lending (Gemstone/Jewelry Industry)
products.description: Secured lending and financing solutions to companies in the gemstone and jewelry industry, primarily through the FlexFIN affiliate, structured as sale/repurchase transactions with collateral held throughout the loan term. This requires specialized underwriting and collateral management.

products.name: Insurance Underwriting and Asset Management
products.description: Underwriting and management of life, accident, health, property, and casualty insurance products, primarily through the National Security Group (NSG) affiliate. Also includes management of investment assets for the insurance business. This business is highly regulated and requires actuarial, underwriting, and investment management expertise.

products.name: Restaurant Operations (Themed Eatertainment)
products.description: Operation of a branded, themed restaurant chain targeting tourists and business travelers in high-traffic locations, primarily through the NVTN LLC affiliate. This business requires physical locations, brand management, and hospitality operations.

products.name: Real Estate Investment and Financing
products.description: Investment in and financing of real estate assets, including equity and debt positions in real estate investment trusts (REITs), mortgage-backed securities, and direct property holdings. This involves capital deployment, asset management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Managerial Assistance to Portfolio Companies
products.description: Provision of managerial, operational, and financial guidance to portfolio companies, including board participation and consulting services. This is offered as required by BDC regulations and may generate fee income.

products.name: Property and Casualty Reinsurance
products.description: Multi-line treaty reinsurance provided to insurance companies globally, covering property, casualty, financial, health, multiline, and specialty risks. Delivered through both proportional and non-proportional structures, requiring regulated underwriting, actuarial analysis, and risk management.

products.name: Specialty Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for specialized risks including agriculture, cyber, marine and energy, aviation and space, war/political violence/terrorism, and other specialty multiline exposures. Delivered via regulated underwriting and often requires domain-specific expertise and syndicate participation.

products.name: Property Catastrophe Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance coverage for commercial property and property catastrophe risks, including protection against losses from natural and human-made disasters. Delivered through both proportional and excess of loss structures, requiring catastrophe modeling and capital management.

products.name: Financial Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for financial lines such as mortgage, trade credit, surety, transactional liability, and financial multiline coverage. Delivered through treaty structures and requires financial risk assessment and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Health Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for accident, critical illness, travel, and other health-related insurance products. Delivered through treaty arrangements and requires actuarial and claims management expertise.

products.name: Casualty Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance for general liability, umbrella, multiline casualty, and workers’ compensation risks. Delivered through treaty structures and requires underwriting and claims management expertise for long-tail risks.

products.name: Multiline Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsurance covering multiple lines of business, including commercial and personal auto liability, business owners’ policy (BOP), and other multiline commercial coverage. Delivered through treaty structures and often includes FAL business at Lloyd’s.

products.name: Innovations Segment Reinsurance Solutions
products.description: Reinsurance capacity and customized solutions provided to startup companies and managing general agents (MGAs), especially in the insurtech sector. Delivered via proportional and non-proportional structures, often leveraging technology-driven underwriting and alternative platforms such as Lloyd’s Syndicate 3456 and Viridis Re captive-as-a-service.

products.name: Uranium Concentrate (U3O8, Yellowcake)
products.description: Physically mined and processed uranium concentrate (U3O8, also known as yellowcake) produced through in-situ recovery (ISR) and conventional mining methods at company-owned mines and processing facilities in the U.S. and Canada. The product is extracted, processed, dried, drummed, and shipped to third-party storage and sales facilities for sale to external customers, primarily utilities and the uranium spot market.

products.name: Physical Uranium Inventory Sales
products.description: Purchase and resale of physical uranium inventory acquired on the spot market and held in storage at conversion facilities, sold to external customers to supplement mining production and support marketing efforts. This is a trading/inventory program rather than mined production.

products.name: Uranium Refining and Conversion Services (Planned)
products.description: Development of uranium refining and conversion services through a proposed new facility in the U.S., intended to process uranium concentrates into forms suitable for nuclear fuel fabrication. This service is in the feasibility and planning stage and not yet operational.

products.name: Conventional Shell Eggs
products.description: Fresh shell eggs produced, processed, packaged, and distributed through vertically integrated operations, including both branded and private-label offerings. Eggs are produced at company-owned and contract farms, cleaned, graded, and packaged at in-line facilities, and delivered to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Specialty Shell Eggs
products.description: A range of value-added shell eggs including cage-free, organic, brown, free-range, pasture-raised, and nutritionally enhanced eggs, produced to meet consumer and regulatory demands for animal welfare and health attributes. Includes both branded and private-label products, with production at company and contract farms.

products.name: Egg Products
products.description: Processed egg products such as liquid and frozen eggs, produced by breaking shell eggs and sold primarily to institutional, foodservice, and food manufacturing sectors. Products are manufactured in specialized facilities and distributed through wholesale channels.

products.name: Prepared Foods (Egg-Based)
products.description: Prepared foods made from eggs, including hard-cooked eggs, egg wraps, protein pancakes, crepes, wrap-ups, waffles, scrambled eggs, frozen cooked omelets, egg patties, toast, and diced eggs. These are produced in dedicated facilities and sold to retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Licensed Toys and Souvenirs
products.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures custom merchandise including toys, figures, plush, accessories, apparel, and homewares based on popular entertainment franchises. Products are physically manufactured and distributed to major theme parks and entertainment venues worldwide.

products.name: TRX Token Treasury and Staking Services
products.description: Acquires, holds, and stakes TRX tokens (the native token of the TRON blockchain) as a digital asset treasury strategy, generating yield through staking and energy rental via decentralized finance protocols. This is a digital-only, blockchain-based financial operation.

products.name: NDV-01 Intravesical Chemotherapy
products.description: A novel, controlled-release intravesical formulation of gemcitabine and docetaxel for the treatment of non muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). It is physically manufactured as a ready-for-use, sustained-release drug product, administered directly into the bladder to provide localized, long-acting chemotherapy with improved patient convenience and efficacy.

products.name: Sepranolone Neurosteroid Therapy
products.description: A synthetic neurosteroid (isoallopregnanolone) developed for the treatment of neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders such as Prader-Willi syndrome (PWS), Tourette Syndrome (TS), essential tremor, and other diseases related to excessive GABAergic activity. It is produced via chemical synthesis and delivered by subcutaneous injection, with clinical development focused on rare and compulsive behavior-related diseases.

products.name: Digital Fitness and Nutrition Subscriptions
products.description: A digital subscription service (BODi) providing unlimited access to an extensive library of on-demand fitness, nutrition, mindfulness, and recovery content, delivered via web and mobile platforms. Content is produced in-house and features well-known trainers and brands, accessible on multiple devices.

products.name: Nutritional Products and Supplements
products.description: A portfolio of branded nutritional products, including Shakeology, Beachbody Performance supplements, and other dietary supplements, formulated and manufactured by third parties to support fitness and weight loss goals. Products are sold direct-to-consumer and, starting in 2026, through retail channels.

products.name: Connected Fitness Equipment (Discontinued)
products.description: Previously sold connected fitness equipment, notably the BODi Bike, which integrated with the digital platform. Manufacturing was outsourced and distribution was through third-party logistics. Sales ceased in Q1 2025.

products.name: Digital & Omni-Channel Customer Experience Services
products.description: End-to-end customer engagement and support services delivered via an omni-channel model (voice, email, chat, SMS, social media), including customer service, technical support, revenue generation (upselling/cross-selling), and outsourced back office functions. Services are delivered through a global network of physical delivery centers and remote work capabilities, leveraging proprietary technology for efficiency and quality.

products.name: Digital Marketing and E-Commerce Solutions
products.description: Technology-driven digital marketing, e-commerce technology, and platform solutions to help clients build, grow, and scale customer acquisition channels. Delivered primarily through proprietary digital platforms and analytics, these services focus on driving digital transformation and customer acquisition for consumer-facing businesses.

products.name: Customer Experience Technology Solutions (Wave iX Platform)
products.description: A proprietary, cloud-based technology platform (Wave iX) offering AI-powered solutions such as virtual agents, real-time translation, speech analytics, and business insights. These solutions automate, personalize, and optimize customer interactions and agent productivity, and are delivered as technology products or add-on solutions to clients.

products.name: Customer Acquisition Services
products.description: Specialized services focused on acquiring new customers for clients, delivered through dedicated Centers of Excellence and leveraging digital platforms, analytics, and targeted outreach. These services are tailored for high-growth, consumer-facing businesses and are supported by both human agents and technology.

products.name: Customer Experience Analytics and Survey Solutions
products.description: Analytics and survey services that measure, monitor, and manage clients’ holistic customer experiences. Delivered as add-on technology solutions (including AI-powered speech analytics) and business analyst support, these offerings provide actionable insights to optimize customer engagement and satisfaction.

products.name: Omnichannel Measurement Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive measurement of sales, market share, and competitive performance across all retail channels (in-store and online), delivered via a cloud-based, AI-powered software platform. Data is collected from retailer point-of-sale, eCommerce, and other sources, harmonized and enriched using proprietary AI models, and accessed by clients through subscription-based software tools.

products.name: Consumer Behavior and Insights Solutions
products.description: Granular insights into shopper behavior, demographics, brand penetration, and purchase drivers across online and in-store channels, using proprietary consumer panels, surveys, and advanced analytics. Delivered through software applications and custom reports, these solutions help clients understand the 'who,' 'what,' 'where,' and 'how much' of consumer purchases.

products.name: Retailer Solutions
products.description: Collaborative analytics and decision support tools for retailers and manufacturers, including supply chain optimization, pricing, assortment, and inventory management. Delivered via integrated software platforms, these solutions leverage proprietary data and analytics to improve operational efficiency and drive value creation for retailers.

products.name: eCommerce Measurement and Analytics
products.description: Specialized measurement and analytics solutions focused on online retail channels, including direct partnerships with eCommerce platforms and digital shelf analytics. These solutions provide clients with insights into online sales performance, product availability, and digital marketing effectiveness, delivered through the unified software platform.

products.name: Innovation and New Product Testing Solutions
products.description: Custom analytics and AI-powered tools for testing, validating, and predicting consumer receptiveness to new product concepts, packaging, and marketing messages. Delivered through proprietary software and generative AI applications, these solutions accelerate product development and innovation cycles for clients.

products.name: Brand and Media Analytics Solutions
products.description: Analytics products that measure brand strength, assess media and advertising effectiveness, and improve audience targeting and personalization. These solutions use proprietary data and AI models to guide marketing investments and optimize campaign performance, delivered via software and custom reports.

products.name: Advanced Analytics and Predictive Modeling Solutions
products.description: Custom and on-demand analytics services, including predictive modeling, pricing optimization, assortment planning, and performance driver identification. Delivered through embedded analytics in the software platform and bespoke consulting, these solutions help clients optimize product, pricing, marketing, and supply chain decisions.

products.name: AI-Powered Consumer Intelligence Platform (Software and Applications)
products.description: A unified, cloud-based software platform (including Discover, gfknewron, and Activate) that integrates all measurement, analytics, and reporting solutions. The platform leverages proprietary AI and machine learning models to deliver real-time, actionable insights and self-serve analytics to clients globally.

products.name: Spinal Implants and Fixation Systems
products.description: A portfolio of specialized spinal implants and fixation systems, including interbody devices and rods, manufactured from materials such as titanium, PEEK, and allograft, designed for various spinal fusion procedures and pathologies. Delivered as physical medical devices for surgical implantation, requiring regulated manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: Surgical Access and Positioning Systems
products.description: Approach-specific patient positioning systems and surgical access instruments, including split-blade retractors and rigid frames, designed to optimize patient positioning and surgical access during spine procedures. These are physical devices used intra-operatively and require regulated manufacturing.

products.name: Biologics for Spinal Fusion
products.description: A range of biologic products, including allograft tissues, demineralized bone matrices, cellular bone matrices, and synthetic grafts, designed to facilitate spinal fusion and bone growth. These are processed human tissue or synthetic materials, distributed under strict regulatory controls.

products.name: Spine Surgery Informatics and Planning Platform (InformatiX)
products.description: A digital informatics platform integrating imaging, neuromonitoring, and surgical planning tools (including EOS imaging, EOS Insight software, SafeOp Neural InformatiX, and Valence robotics), providing actionable data before, during, and after spine surgery. Delivered as a combination of hardware (imaging systems, robotics) and software (planning, analytics), requiring regulatory clearance.

products.name: Imaging Systems for Spine Care (EOS Imaging)
products.description: Full-body, calibrated 3D imaging systems (EOS and EOS Edge) for diagnostic and surgical planning applications in spine care, providing high-quality images and data for pre-operative and post-operative assessment. Delivered as regulated medical imaging hardware installed in clinical settings.

products.name: Neuromonitoring Systems (SafeOp)
products.description: Proprietary intra-operative neuromonitoring systems (SafeOp) providing real-time, automated EMG, SSEP, and MEP monitoring to inform surgeons about nerve location and health during spine surgery. Delivered as regulated medical devices used in the operating room.

products.name: Robotic Navigation Systems (Valence)
products.description: Intra-operative navigation and robotics systems (Valence) that guide instrumentation and implants during spine surgery, integrating with imaging and planning platforms to enhance precision and reduce radiation exposure. Delivered as regulated hardware and software for use in surgical settings.

products.name: Customized Debt Financing Solutions for Lower Middle Market Companies
products.description: Provision of secured debt investments, including single tranche and mezzanine loans, to lower middle market companies in the U.S., typically involving physical underwriting, due diligence, and ongoing portfolio management. These loans are tailored to each company's needs and are delivered through direct origination and relationship-based sourcing.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Related Investments in Lower Middle Market Companies
products.description: Direct equity investments and equity-related securities (such as warrants) in lower middle market companies, often made alongside debt investments to align interests and participate in capital appreciation. These are structured and managed by in-house investment professionals and may involve board representation.

products.name: Private Loan Debt Financing for Private Equity-Owned Companies
products.description: Origination and provision of secured debt investments to private companies owned by or being acquired by private equity funds, typically through direct origination or club deals. These loans are structured with first priority liens and are managed through a collaborative process with private equity sponsors.

products.name: Legacy Middle Market Debt Investments
products.description: Management of a legacy portfolio of secured debt investments in larger middle market companies, originally issued through syndication. These are not a current focus for new investment but continue to generate income as they are repaid or sold.

products.name: Asset Management and Investment Advisory Services for External Parties
products.description: Provision of investment management, advisory, and administrative services to external clients, including funds and separately managed accounts, through a registered investment adviser subsidiary. Services are delivered digitally and through professional staff, generating management and incentive fees.

products.name: Investments in Unaffiliated Investment Companies and Private Funds
products.description: Investment in third-party managed investment companies and private funds, primarily as part of a limited 'Other Portfolio.' These are financial investments rather than direct products or services delivered to customers.

products.name: P&C Insurance Data, Analytics, and Decision Support Solutions
products.description: Integrated data, analytics, and technology solutions for property and casualty (P&C) insurers, including predictive analytics, decision support, and workflow tools for rating, underwriting, claims, catastrophe, and risk management. Delivered primarily via cloud-based and on-premise software platforms and proprietary databases.

products.name: Industry-Standard Insurance Programs (Forms, Rules, and Loss Costs)
products.description: Development and provision of standardized policy language, rating rules, and prospective loss costs for P&C insurers, ensuring regulatory compliance and supporting product development, underwriting, and pricing. Delivered as turnkey insurance programs and regulatory filings across multiple lines of insurance.

products.name: Statistical Agent and Actuarial Services
products.description: Collection, aggregation, and reporting of insurance premium and loss data for regulatory compliance, as well as actuarial analysis and consulting for pricing, loss reserving, and market analysis. Services are based on proprietary databases and advanced actuarial models.

products.name: Underwriting Data and Analytics Solutions
products.description: Provision of property, auto, and community data and analytics to support risk selection, segmentation, and pricing for personal and commercial insurance. Includes field inspections, geospatial data, and predictive analytics delivered via digital platforms and APIs.

products.name: Catastrophe Modeling and Risk Solutions
products.description: Probabilistic catastrophe modeling and risk quantification solutions for insurers, reinsurers, financial institutions, and governments to assess and manage exposure to natural and man-made catastrophes. Delivered through proprietary models, geospatial analytics, and reporting platforms.

products.name: Life Insurance and Annuity Solutions
products.description: Digital platforms and analytics for life insurance and annuities, including no-code policy administration, underwriting, claims, compliance, fraud detection, and actuarial modeling. Delivered via the FAST platform and related software and analytics tools.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Software Solutions
products.description: End-to-end software suite for specialty insurance and reinsurance markets, especially the London market, covering policy negotiation, placement, pricing, administration, claims, and outwards reinsurance. Delivered as integrated digital platforms and marketplace solutions.

products.name: Claims Analytics and Management Solutions
products.description: Analytics, workflow, and collaboration tools for insurance claims management, including fraud detection, compliance, subrogation, litigation, repair cost estimation, and virtual claims adjusting. Delivered via cloud-based and on-premise platforms, APIs, and proprietary databases.

products.name: Property Estimating and Repair Cost Solutions
products.description: Data, analytics, and software for estimating building repair and reconstruction costs, supporting insurance claims settlement and contractor workflows. Includes patented plan-sketching tools, price lists, and a large structural repair and cleaning database, updated regularly.

products.name: Anti-Fraud Solutions
products.description: Fraud detection and prevention tools for P&C insurers, leveraging the world’s largest claims database, predictive analytics, network analysis, and digital media forensics. Delivered as integrated analytics and workflow solutions for claims processing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Casualty and Bodily Injury Solutions
products.description: Compliance, decision support, and workflow automation solutions for casualty and bodily injury claims, including Medicare Secondary Payer compliance, workers’ compensation reporting, severity scoring, and automated medical record review. Delivered via digital platforms and AI-powered tools.

products.name: International Insurance Solutions
products.description: Data, analytics, and software solutions tailored for international P&C and specialty insurance markets, including property and casualty underwriting, claims, risk modeling, and benchmarking tools. Delivered digitally and adapted for local regulatory and market needs.

products.name: Edge Cloud Platform
products.description: A unified, programmable platform that delivers, secures, and accelerates digital experiences at the edge of the internet, integrating content delivery, edge computing, and application security. Delivered as a cloud-based service with a global network of points of presence.

products.name: Content Delivery Network (CDN) Services
products.description: Accelerates and optimizes the delivery of web and application content, including dynamic and static assets, through a global network, with features like dynamic site acceleration, instant purge, origin shield, and content compression. Delivered as a managed cloud service.

products.name: Edge Computing and Serverless Compute
products.description: Provides a programmable, serverless compute environment at the edge, enabling customers to deploy and run code (using WASM-supported languages) close to end users for low-latency, secure, and scalable application logic. Delivered as a cloud-based service integrated with the CDN.

products.name: Unified Application and API Security
products.description: A suite of integrated security solutions including Next-Gen Web Application Firewall (WAF), DDoS protection, bot management, API security, account takeover protection, and client-side protection, designed to protect websites, applications, and APIs from attacks and abuse. Delivered as software services layered on the edge platform.

products.name: Video and Streaming Delivery Services
products.description: Delivers live and on-demand video content at scale, with features such as live streaming, video on demand, media shield, cache reservation, and live event monitoring, leveraging the edge platform for high performance and reliability. Delivered as a managed service for media and entertainment customers.

products.name: Edge Data Storage Solutions
products.description: Provides Amazon S3-compatible object storage and key-value store at the edge, enabling customers to store, access, and serve large files and data with low latency, supporting both CDN and compute workloads. Delivered as a cloud storage service integrated with the edge platform.

products.name: Load Balancing Services
products.description: Manages and distributes HTTP/HTTPS traffic across multiple origins, data centers, or cloud providers using content-aware routing for improved performance and reliability. Delivered as a cloud-based service integrated with the edge platform.

products.name: Image Optimization Services
products.description: Provides real-time image manipulation, resizing, and optimization at the edge, reducing latency and infrastructure costs by transforming images on demand before delivery to end users or AI models. Delivered as a cloud-based service integrated with CDN and compute.

products.name: TLS Certificate Management and Encryption Services
products.description: Provides TLS/SSL certificate management, termination, and acceleration at the edge, including a proprietary certificate authority (Certainly), to secure web and API traffic for customers at scale. Delivered as a managed security service integrated with the edge platform.

products.name: Observability and Monitoring Services
products.description: Offers real-time logging, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and analytics tools for monitoring the performance, security, and usage of customer applications and services delivered via the Fastly platform. Delivered as a suite of cloud-based observability tools and add-ons.

products.name: AI Workload Acceleration and Management
products.description: Provides specialized features for accelerating, protecting, and optimizing AI-driven workloads, including semantic caching, edge data stores, AI bot management, and real-time messaging for agentic AI traffic. Delivered as enhancements and integrations within the edge platform.

products.name: Professional and Managed Services
products.description: Offers consulting, implementation, managed security, managed CDN, and technical support services to help customers optimize, secure, and operate their Fastly deployments. Delivered by Fastly experts as add-on service engagements.
